review_candidates.title: L3 Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities L3 Network Support & Troubleshooting - Provide L3 technical support for complex network incidents escalated from L1/L2 teams. - Troubleshoot complex issues across LAN, WAN, Internet, WLAN, VPN, routing, switching, and firewall environments. - Lead troubleshooting for major incidents and provide technical support during critical outages. Network Infrastructure Management Provide hands-on support and administration across a multi-vendor network environment, including: - Cisco
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: As the Architects of Change™, we combine global expertise with local insight to help organisations accelerate their journey toward becoming AI-ready enterprises. You'll grow through hands-on experience with the world's leading technology partners, supported by investment in certifications, consulting capability, and cross-border opportunity. Network Infrastructure Management Provide hands-on support and administration across a multi-vendor network environment, including: - Cisco – Routers, switches, Catalyst, Nexus and related networking technologies. - Work closely with cybersecurity teams on network security requirements. - Strong hands-on experience with routing and switching. Qualifications & Experience - Diploma or Degree in IT, Computer Science, Networking or a related discipline. - 5–8+ years of network engineering experience, with strong L3 troubleshooting experience. - Hands-on
